description: c14 with attention projections at BFP8 instead of BFP4. Not a throughput candidate: the sweep measured this geometry (c00-baseline-attn8-mlp4-kv8-lofi) at 38.036 t/s/u against c14's 38.226 -- 0.5% slower at the same top-1 0.99. The hypothesis is that DFlash acceptance depends on the target's argmax fidelity, which top-1 at 0.99 resolution cannot resolve and which the sweep's ranking metric (non-speculative t/s/u) does not reward.

embedding.note: structural: ttnn.embedding needs a ROW_MAJOR BF16 table

norms.note: structural: every RMSNorm weight is packed BF16

ccl.decode_dtype_note: null means the collective carries the activation dtype

provenance.selection_reason: Acceptance is the multiplier on every per-iteration DFlash term. Three datapoints on this checkpoint: CPU target + CPU drafter 5.33 accepted/forward (F1), device target + HF drafter 2.57, device target + device drafter 2.50 (F15) -- i.e. the device target's argmax is what rejects drafts, not the drafter. This moves precision back up exactly where argmax is decided and nowhere else.
